title: Minimax Annealed Treatment Assignment with Known Cell Masses and Quotas
banked_reason: D-0.5 final verdict NO-PASS after angle 0 exhausted six revisions; remaining flag: N-thin-survey — Add BhattacharyaDupas2012 and distinguish its plug-in/inference target from the reverse-KL worst-risk game.
gap_reasons: N-thin-survey — Add BhattacharyaDupas2012, a directly relevant published capacity-constrained treatment-assignment comparator identified in SunadaIzumi2025s related-work discussion, and distinguish its plug-in/inference target from the reverse-KL worst-risk game.
proof_attempt_summary: Six proposal revisions developed a framed Gaussian capacity geometry with explicit transported face experiments, a scalar reverse-KL saddle, compatible global-minimax obligations, a Helmert-framed three-cell certificate, and a causal LAN program. The final reviewer found no soundness or source-characterization defect and retained a field assessment, but returned NO-PASS for one unresolved survey-comparison omission; the authorized retry budget was exhausted, so no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: Known target-cell masses and quota define a framed Gaussian capacity geometry whose fixed orthonormal tangent frame determines the covariance coordinates, every comparator, and every escape direction. Each exposed face has an explicit affine action chart, observation isometry, transported oracle, loss, risk, and defined face rule, while representative-invariant local-Gaussian metrics state global-to-face and nested-face compatibility. The canonically normalized scalar game has a posterior-mean reverse-KL minimax rule and unbounded countable least-favorable support. The main open kernel asks for one global minimax map compatible in the displayed metrics, polynomial finite-code value and map certificates, and a six-edge numerical separation in the explicit three-cell Helmert experiment. A normalized full-data tilt, finite-sample regret, clipped finite-cell cross-fitting, and capacity-preserving evaluation retain the causal lower-bound, attainment, and inference program with supplied \(p\) and \(q\).
gap: SunadaIzumi2025 Proposition 3.2 selects the unique \(H\)-minimizer over posterior-optimal couplings, while Theorem 3.3 proves average optimality under Assumptions 3.1--3.6; its posterior-average objective is distinct from worst-risk minimax existence and nested-face compatibility. Sun2026 studies welfare maximization with estimated budget or cost constraints rather than a supplied-mass local minimax game. DaidoKido2023 gives a local-minimax rule for scalar partially identified welfare, KitagawaLeeQiu2026 solves a scalar Gaussian fractional rule for another nonlinear loss, HiranoPorter2009 treats unconstrained local decisions, and LuedtkeVanderLaan2016RC studies resource-limited stochastic rules and regular value inference. None supplies the aggregate-capacity reverse-KL game, its six-edge compatibility certificates, or covariance-stable attainment.
fill: The scalar saddle and the framed face-reduction theorem lead to three falsifiable obligations stated in one coordinate system: global minimax existence with compatibility in the displayed local-Gaussian metrics, fixed-dimensional finite-code value and expected-KL map recovery, and a numerical certificate on the Helmert-framed three-cell experiment. The same fixed frame enters the normalized full-data path, finite-sample oracle regret, finite-set LAN lower bound, measurable clipped finite-cell learner, and quantified joint policy-welfare confidence set.
